_doc: Experiment A (multiturn/paper_photos_plan.md section 9): 5-turn chains on paper photos, direct force on every turn. 11/27: every turn pushes one object TOWARD another so they collide (angle 'toward:<obj>' = direction from the target's tracked centroid to that object's centroid at the end of the previous turn; turn 1 uses the clicks). Force per scene is small (100-150) so objects stay in frame. One seed (0).
